name: @vln-devsecops/vlinder-auth-edge-functions-build
description: Transpiles the vlinder_auth module's CloudFront Function sources (templates/src/*.js, normal modern JS) down to templates/dist/*.js, the ES2019-ish subset that the cloudfront-js-2.0 runtime actually accepts (no optional chaining, no nullish coalescing). Run `npm run build` after editing anything in ../templates/src/; CI re-runs it and diffs the result against committed dist/ to catch stale or hand-edited output. See ../doc/cloudfront-js-runtime-compatibility.md.
